title: The Space console on a phone is one top bar, a bottom bar and a More sheet, with every control kept

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project chat: the Space console experience on mobile is trash; proposal /mnt/project-files/console-mobile/console-mobile-proposal-2026-10-20.md, approved 'Do it'

detail: FILED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: at 390px the console's header stack was 335px (40% of the screen), the nav labels overlapped (Page editor, Community Resonance, Market), the first stat sat at about 700px, and the five shortcut pills wrapped raggedly. Under 960px the 264px sidebar folded into a wrapping row above the page and the top bar sat under it. THE FIX (shell, PR 1 of 3): under 960px the sidebar steps aside for a 60px top bar (who, search, alerts, you), the member app's floating frosted bar at the bottom (Home, Community, Programs, Money, More; slots come from AdminNavItem.phone and phoneSlots) and a More sheet (switcher, Marketing, Profile & Settings, Page editor, the Go to links, Back to Frequency, Help). The section's pages stay a strip under the top bar. The bar sets the lane tokens so the chat launcher and toasts ride above it. Wide screens are untouched. PR 2 is the Home order and the shortcut tile grid, PR 3 checks the launcher clearance on a real phone.

verify.note: The probe fails on main (no phone console block) and passes with the shell.
